title: ErrorModelSpecification
description: Classification taxonomy, error codes, fail-closed rules, and fallback mappings for controlled_integration.

ERR_FF_01.name: EmergencyModeActive
ERR_FF_01.description: Operating mode is EMERGENCY_DISABLED. All sub-flags forced to false.

ERR_FF_02.name: InvalidFlagCombination
ERR_FF_02.description: Incompatible feature flags enabled simultaneously (e.g. Gate B without Official Retrieval).

ERR_FF_03.name: UnknownFlagKey
ERR_FF_03.description: Unrecognized flag key present in configuration.

ERR_BND_01.name: UnreviewedNoveltyLeak
ERR_BND_01.description: Gate C candidate with status DISCOVERY_ONLY attempted to cross into Gate D.
ERR_BND_01.fail_closed_action: Block candidate immediately, raise security audit alarm, fallback to LEGACY_ONLY.

ERR_BND_02.name: PendingReviewLeak
ERR_BND_02.description: Candidate with review_status PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW attempted to cross into Gate D.
ERR_BND_02.fail_closed_action: Block candidate immediately, fallback to LEGACY_ONLY.

ERR_BND_03.name: UnresolvedContradictionLeak
ERR_BND_03.description: Candidate with POSSIBLE_CONTRADICTION attempted to cross into Gate D.
ERR_BND_03.fail_closed_action: Block candidate, exclude from consultation input bundle.

ERR_BND_04.name: InsufficientEvidenceLeak
ERR_BND_04.description: Candidate failing confidence threshold attempted to cross boundary.
ERR_BND_04.fail_closed_action: Exclude item from consultation input bundle.

ERR_GATE_B.name: GateBReasoningFailure
ERR_GATE_B.description: Exception encountered during Gate B traversal evaluation.
ERR_GATE_B.fail_closed_action: Log error, fall back to simple keyword retrieval.

ERR_GATE_C.name: GateCNoveltyEngineFailure
ERR_GATE_C.description: Exception encountered during Gate C novelty discovery.
ERR_GATE_C.fail_closed_action: Bypass Gate C novelty, continue with official evidence only.

ERR_GATE_D.name: GateDConsultationFailure
ERR_GATE_D.description: Exception encountered during Gate D consultation generation.

ERR_DEP_IO.name: ForbiddenExternalIOCall
ERR_DEP_IO.description: Attempted live network, Neo4j, or LLM call within controlled integration adapter.
ERR_DEP_IO.fail_closed_action: Abort call, log critical security alarm, execute legacy fallback.

ERR_DEP_WRITE.name: ForbiddenKnowledgeWrite
ERR_DEP_WRITE.description: Attempted graph mutation or official knowledge modification.

fallback_mapping_rules.action: Graceful degradation: exclude faulty item, continue pipeline if safe.
